newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: GOLF-CADDIE TREATED AFTER COLLISION.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-CADDIE TREATED AFTER COLLISION.

text.p: Nick Faldo's Swedish caddie Fanny Sunesson was badly dazed after hitting her head on an advertising hoarding during the final round of the Irish Open on Sunday.
Sunesson was felled as she walked towards the fourth tee and received treatment from a doctor in the crowd.

"Some guy came from the crowd and carried my bag to the fourth," said Faldo. "It was fortunate Fanny recovered because he gave me the wrong club. I'd thought about getting a five-minute medical break for her because she was really shaken."
